Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by their 2025 building permit counts, left-joining pre-aggregated tract counts so zero-permit tracts appear with 0.
sql:
WITH permit_counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS permit_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_5dabc1'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT
  t.name,
  COALESCE(p.permit_count, 0) AS permit_count,
  t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts AS t
LEFT JOIN permit_counts AS p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
ORDER BY permit_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
